mapper.select: SELECT tdatetime, bcf1_cf_pv, bcf1_oil_pv, (bcf1_cp_pv * 0.001) AS bcf1_cp_pv, bcf2_cf_pv, (bcf2_cp_pv * 0.001) AS bcf2_cp_pv, bcf3_cf_pv, bcf3_oil_pv, (bcf3_cp_pv * 0.001) AS bcf3_cp_pv, bcf4_cf_pv, bcf4_oil_pv, (bcf4_cp_pv * 0.001) AS bcf4_cp_pv, bcf5_cf_pv, bcf5_oil_pv, bcf5_cp_pv, tf1_zone1, tf1_zone2, tf1_zone3 FROM tb_temp WHERE tdatetime BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY tdatetime

SELECT jisi_lot, jisi_lot_view, prod_name, corp_name, CONCAT(now_temp,';',pre) AS pre, CONCAT(now_temp,';',chim) AS chim, CONCAT(now_temp,';',diff) AS diff, CONCAT(now_temp,';',gang) AS gang, CONCAT(now_temp,';',cold) AS cold FROM ( SELECT jisi_lot, jisi_lot_view, prod_name, corp_name, pre, chim, diff, gang, cold, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(jisi_lot,7,1) = 1 THEN CONCAT('로내온도:',bcf1_cf_pv,';유조온도:',bcf1_oil_pv,';CP:',bcf1_cp_pv) WHEN SUBSTRING(jisi_lot,7,1) = 2 THEN CONCAT('로내온도:',bcf2_cf_pv,';유조온도:',bcf2_oil_pv,';CP:',bcf2_cp_pv) WHEN SUBSTRING(jisi_lot,7,1) = 3 THEN CONCAT('로내온도:',bcf3_cf_pv,';유조온도:',bcf3_oil_pv,';CP:',bcf3_cp_pv) WHEN SUBSTRING(jisi_lot,7,1) = 4 THEN CONCAT('로내온도:',bcf4_cf_pv,';유조온도:',bcf4_oil_pv,';CP:',bcf4_cp_pv) WHEN SUBSTRING(jisi_lot,7,1) = 5 THEN CONCAT('로내온도:',bcf5_cf_pv,';유조온도:',bcf5_oil_pv,';CP:',bcf5_cp_pv) END AS now_temp FROM ( SELECT A.jisi_lot, A.jisi_lot_view, C.prod_name, D.corp_name, CONCAT('설정온도:',A.jisi_h_pre_temp,';','설정시간:',A.jisi_h_pre_time,';', CASE WHEN A.jisi_h_pre_cp = NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('설정CP:',A.jisi_h_pre_cp) END) AS pre, CONCAT('설정온도:',A.jisi_h_chim_temp,';','설정시간:',A.jisi_h_chim_time,';',CASE WHEN A.jisi_h_chim_cp = NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('설정CP:',A.jisi_h_chim_cp) END) AS chim, CONCAT('설정온도:',A.jisi_h_diff_temp,';','설정시간:',A.jisi_h_diff_time,';',CASE WHEN A.jisi_h_diff_cp = NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('설정CP:',A.jisi_h_diff_cp) END) AS diff, CONCAT('설정온도:',A.jisi_h_gang_temp,';','설정시간:',A.jisi_h_gang_time,';',CASE WHEN A.jisi_h_gang_cp = NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('설정CP:',A.jisi_h_gang_cp) END) AS gang, CONCAT('설정온도:',A.jisi_h_cold_temp,';','설정시간:',A.jisi_h_cold_time,';',CASE WHEN A.jisi_h_cold_cp = NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('설정CP:',A.jisi_h_cold_cp) END) AS cold, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf1_cf_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf1_cf_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf1_oil_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf1_oil_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf1_cp_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf1_cp_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf2_cf_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf2_cf_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf2_oil_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf2_oil_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf2_cp_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf2_cp_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf3_cf_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf3_cf_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf3_oil_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf3_oil_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf3_cp_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf3_cp_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf4_cf_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf4_cf_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf4_oil_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf4_oil_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf4_cp_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf4_cp_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf5_cf_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf5_cf_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf5_oil_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf5_oil_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 bcf5_cp_pv FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS bcf5_cp_pv, (SELECT TOP 1 tf1_zone1 FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS tf1_zone_1, (SELECT TOP 1 tf1_zone2 FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS tf1_zone_2, (SELECT TOP 1 tf1_zone3 FROM tb_temp ORDER BY tdatetime DESC) AS tf1_zone_3 FROM tb_workheat A LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT B ON A.jisi_ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON B.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON C.corp_code = D.corp_code WHERE jisi_lot = #{lot_qr} ) AS A ) AS B

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT hogi, MIN(hogi_idx) AS hogi_idx, STUFF( (SELECT ';'+cutum FROM tb_monitoring_real A WHERE A.hogi = B.hogi FOR xml PATH('') ),1,1,'') AS cutum, STUFF( (SELECT ';'+pum FROM tb_monitoring_real A WHERE A.hogi = B.hogi FOR xml PATH('') ),1,1,'') AS pum, MAX(lot) AS lot, MAX(pre) AS pre, MAX(chim) AS chim, MAX(diff) AS diff, MAX(gang) AS gang, MAX(cold) AS cold, MAX(chul) AS chul, MAX(lot_qr) AS lot_qr FROM tb_monitoring_real B GROUP BY hogi ) AS A
